# art-aspect-ratio



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Aspect Ratio — shadcn/ui parity. Constrains its content to a ratio (`16/9`, `1`, `4/3`)
with the native `aspect-ratio` property; the slotted element fills the box.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                                           | Type               | Default |
| -------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ------- |
| `ratio`  | `ratio`   | Width / height: `"16/9"`, `"1"`, `"4/3"` or a number. | `number \| string` | `'1'`   |


## Slots

| Slot | Description                                                                                 |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
|      | The content (an `<img>`, `<video>`, `<iframe>` or any element); it is stretched to the box. |
